findings.summary: Tab list is built from div elements with no roles.
findings.fix: Add role="tablist" to the container, role="tab" to each control, role="tabpanel" to each panel, and wire aria-controls and aria-selected.

findings.summary: Redundant role on a semantic element.
findings.fix: Remove role="article" from the article element; the element already carries that role.

findings.summary: A flex row splits one phrase (author and timestamp) into two accessibility objects, so VoiceOver takes two swipes for one line.
findings.fix: Wrap the author and timestamp in a single inline span and make that the one flex child, or add a real separator character between them in a non-hidden span.

passed: No aria-hidden on a focusable element
notes: Whether the tab panel updates on arrow keys needs a runtime check.
